Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller

Class ApiKeyController

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller.ApiKeyController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/keys") public class ApiKeyController extends Object
REST controller for managing API keys.

Provides endpoints to create, list, and delete API keys for the authenticated user. Key creation is gated by subscription tier (SUBSCRIBER/ENTERPRISE/ADMIN only) with per-tier key count limits. Deletion requires ownership verification — only the key owner or an ADMIN can delete a key.

  • Method Details

    • createKey

      @PostMapping public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<ApiKeyResponse> createKey(@RequestBody ApiKeyRequest request, Principal principal)
      Creates a new API key for the authenticated user.

      Only SUBSCRIBER, ENTERPRISE, and ADMIN users can create keys. Key count is limited per tier: SUBSCRIBER=3, ENTERPRISE=10, ADMIN=unlimited.

      Parameters:
      request - the key creation request containing the key name
      principal - the authenticated user
      Returns:
      201 Created with the API key response (including raw key)

    • listKeys

      @GetMapping public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<List<ApiKeyResponse>> listKeys(Principal principal)
      Lists all API keys owned by the authenticated user.
      Parameters:
      principal - the authenticated user
      Returns:
      200 OK with the list of API keys (without raw keys)

    • deleteKey

      @DeleteMapping("/{id}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> deleteKey(@PathVariable String id, Principal principal)
      Deletes an API key by ID. Only the key owner or an ADMIN can delete.
      Parameters:
      id - the API key ID to delete
      principal - the authenticated user
      Returns:
      204 No Content on success
